name: A foreign state pension (Italian INPS) received in Bellinzona
workings: Under Art. 18 of the Italy–Switzerland treaty a private-sector INPS pension of a Swiss resident is taxed only in Switzerland (EUR 20,000 at 0.93 CHF/EUR = CHF 18,600).
Federal taxable 18,600 − 2,700 = 15,900: 0.77% × 700 = 5.39, under the CHF 25 that's levied (DBG Art. 36 para. 3), so no federal tax. (The draft case had 5.39: it missed the minimum.)

Ticino: net income 18,600 − 5,500 = 13,100, at most 21,000, so the full 8,000 deduction for single people; taxable 5,100; simple 0.16% × 5,100 = 8.1600; cantonal 8.1600, communal 93% = 7.5888; personal tax 40 (verify).
